l4_steps.name: Ingest METAR/TAF feeds from NWS/NOAA
l4_steps.input: Automated weather station transmissions from NWS ASOS/AWOS network
l4_steps.output: Normalised METAR/TAF data loaded into weather workstation
l4_steps.kpi: Data refresh latency ≤5 min for all airports in route network
l4_steps.pain_point: NWS ASOS outages at smaller spoke airports create data gaps; GoDirect fallback to model-derived obs introduces ±3°C temperature error affecting performance calculations

l4_steps.name: Ingest SIGMET, AIRMET & convective outlook
l4_steps.input: NWS Aviation Weather Center SIGMET/AIRMET issuances; convective outlooks (Day 1–3)
l4_steps.output: Active SIGMET/AIRMET polygons overlaid on route map
l4_steps.kpi: 100% of active domestic SIGMETs captured within 10 min of NWS issuance
l4_steps.pain_point: International SIGMET ingestion via SADIS requires separate subscription; coverage gaps over oceanic tracks (OTS) require manual cross-check against NAT SIGMET bulletins

l4_steps.name: Validate data currency and completeness
l4_steps.input: All ingested weather feeds from steps 1.1 and 1.2
l4_steps.output: Data quality flag (Pass/Fail) per station; stale-data alerts for gaps >30 min
l4_steps.kpi: ≥98% of route-relevant stations reporting within 30-min window at pre-departure check
l4_steps.pain_point: No automated alerting when upstream NWS feed drops; dispatcher must manually notice missing station data during busy multi-departure windows

l4_steps.name: Analyse route-specific weather hazards
l4_steps.input: Active SIGMETs, radar composites, turbulence prog charts, icing PIREPs
l4_steps.output: Route weather hazard summary per flight: turbulence, icing, CB/convective activity, low-level wind shear flags
l4_steps.kpi: Hazard assessment completed ≥45 min before scheduled departure (D-45)
l4_steps.pain_point: Rapidly developing convection (pop-up cells) outpaces 1-hourly radar update cycle; AviationSentry nowcast accuracy degrades beyond +3 hr for mesoscale convective systems

l4_steps.name: Assess departure, destination & alternate wx
l4_steps.input: Current METAR/TAF for departure, destination, and minimum two alternates
l4_steps.output: Ceiling/visibility/wind report per airport; go/no-go flag against FAR Part 121.619 alternate minima
l4_steps.kpi: Alternate airport identification completed for 100% of IFR releases within D-60
l4_steps.pain_point: TAF validity windows (±1 hr) create ambiguity at scheduled arrival time; low-frequency alternates may lack TAF service, requiring meteorological judgement unsupported by system data

l4_steps.name: Classify weather threat level against ops specs
l4_steps.input: Route hazard summary from 2.1; airport assessments from 2.2; airline ops specs (OpSpec A002/A025)
l4_steps.output: Threat classification: Green / Amber / Red per flight; Amber/Red triggers reroute or hold evaluation
l4_steps.kpi: Zero flights released into Red-classified weather corridor without Duty Manager override sign-off
l4_steps.pain_point: OpSpec thresholds for convective avoidance (20 nm lateral separation from CBs) not programmatically enforced in AviationSentry; relies on dispatcher visual judgement of radar returns

l4_steps.name: Cross-reference weather threats with flight plans
l4_steps.input: Red/Amber threat polygons from 2.3; active flight plan waypoints and airways
l4_steps.output: Conflict list: flights whose planned route intersects active hazard polygon within ±30 NM buffer
l4_steps.kpi: 100% of active flight plans checked against current SIGMET polygons pre-departure
l4_steps.pain_point: NAVBLUE polygon overlay requires manual SIGMET boundary entry when NWS feed XML schema changes; integration SLA between NWS and NAVBLUE API is 15 min, creating a window of stale data

l4_steps.name: Calculate fuel burn impact of weather deviations
l4_steps.input: Proposed deviation routing around hazard polygons; aircraft performance model (B737-800/MAX 8)
l4_steps.output: Revised fuel burn delta vs. filed plan; go/no-go flag against minimum fuel uplift threshold
l4_steps.kpi: Fuel recalculation turnaround ≤8 min per rerouted flight to preserve D-45 release window
l4_steps.pain_point: NAVBLUE performance model uses scheduled aircraft type; last-minute tail swaps (B737-700 for -800) require re-entry of performance data manually — no automated tail-type pull from Altéa OCC

l4_steps.name: Verify alternate airport weather acceptability
l4_steps.input: Revised alternate candidates after route deviation; current METAR/TAF at alternate(s)
l4_steps.output: Confirmed alternate airport(s) meeting FAR 121.619 ceiling/visibility minima at ETA ±1 hr
l4_steps.kpi: Alternate confirmation completed for 100% of IFR dispatch releases before crew briefing
l4_steps.pain_point: Peak-demand periods force simultaneous alternate re-evaluation for multiple flights; limited dispatcher bandwidth increases risk of using stale TAF data beyond 6-hour validity window

l4_steps.name: Issue or withhold dispatch weather release
l4_steps.input: Approved routing, fuel plan, and alternate from Phase 3; threat classification from 2.3
l4_steps.output: Signed dispatch release (FAR 121.663) with weather addendum; or hold notification to crew scheduling
l4_steps.kpi: ≤2% of departures held >30 min beyond SOBT for weather-related dispatch rework
l4_steps.pain_point: Dispatcher joint release authority requires co-sign from PIC; when crew is in-bound the electronic co-sign workflow in NAVBLUE times out after 15 min, forcing a manual paper release process

l4_steps.name: Brief flight crew on significant weather via EFB
l4_steps.input: Dispatch release with weather addendum; radar snapshots; SIGMET polygons; turbulence PIREPs
l4_steps.output: Weather briefing package pushed to crew EFB ≥30 min before departure; crew acknowledgment record
l4_steps.kpi: Crew acknowledgment of weather briefing received for 100% of Amber/Red-classified departures
l4_steps.pain_point: EFB push notification delivery confirmation is not real-time; dispatcher cannot distinguish between un-delivered and unread briefings, risking undocumented crew awareness gaps before FAR 121.601 compliance check

l4_steps.name: Confirm crew acceptance of dispatch release
l4_steps.input: Dispatch release and weather briefing from 4.2
l4_steps.output: Crew acceptance message (ACARS uplink) or crew request for amended release
l4_steps.kpi: Crew acceptance ACARS message received ≥20 min before SOBT for 95% of departures
l4_steps.pain_point: ACARS acceptance workflow is non-standardised across gate types; at congested gates crews sometimes provide verbal acceptance to ground ops without ACARS confirmation, leaving no auditable record for FAR 121.663

l4_steps.name: Monitor en-route convective activity in real time
l4_steps.input: Airborne flight position data (ADS-B via FlightAware); updated radar mosaics refreshed every 5 min
l4_steps.output: Live flight track overlaid on convective radar; proximity alert if cell within 30 NM of track
l4_steps.kpi: Dispatcher workstation refresh ≤5 min; proximity alert generated within 2 min of threshold breach
l4_steps.pain_point: Single dispatcher managing 15–20 simultaneous en-route flights cannot sustain continuous radar monitoring; AviationSentry automated proximity alerting requires manual polygon configuration per flight and resets on sector boundary crossings

l4_steps.name: Evaluate PIREP and crew weather deviation reports
l4_steps.input: In-flight PIREP uplinks (turbulence severity, icing level, CB observations); crew position reports
l4_steps.output: Updated route hazard picture; PIREP filed with ATC for distribution to following aircraft
l4_steps.kpi: PIREP relay to NWS/ATC within 15 min of crew report for 90% of severe turbulence encounters
l4_steps.pain_point: PIREP data entry format inconsistency between crews (free-text vs. structured ACARS form) reduces automated parsing accuracy in AviationSentry; significant events may be missed in multi-flight monitoring queue

l4_steps.name: Assess need for divert, reroute or amended release
l4_steps.input: Updated weather picture from 5.1 and 5.2; remaining fuel on board (ACARS fuel telemetry); nearest alternate airports
l4_steps.output: Amended dispatch release with revised routing or divert authorisation; ACARS uplink to crew
l4_steps.kpi: Amended release issued within 10 min of divert-trigger threshold being met; zero diversions without prior dispatcher-crew coordination
l4_steps.pain_point: Amended release workflow in NAVBLUE requires re-opening a filed plan and triggers full recalculation; under time pressure dispatchers sometimes relay route changes verbally without formal amended release, creating FAR 121.663 compliance exposure
